'''Purple Werm''' was an establishment in a seedy part of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. It was situated right between [[Playland Theatre/Legends|Playland Theatre]] and [[Ihouse/Legends|Ihouse]]. The facade showed pictures of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] faces and carried a [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] neon sign, which spelled out the name.<ref name="HH" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] stayed in an apartment right across the street from the business, while planning a [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|raid on the Jedi Temple]]. At the time, the light had gone out in the last letter of the Purple Werm sign, making it look like the establishment was called "Purple Wer."<ref name="HH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The old [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Clone Wars'']] episode guide on the [[StarWars.com]] erroneously refers to the establishment as "Purple Wer";<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}}</ref> probably because there is no light in the last symbol.<ref name="HH" />

During pre-production, the establishment was called "[[Felucia/Legends|Felucian]] Loveshack " as seen in concept art of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].<ref name="SW-Holocron Heist - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep201|text="Holocron Heist" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Concept Art Gallery, slide 10}}</ref>
